title: 工作出錯好好道歉
subtitle: 12 句英文，搞砸了也能挽回信任

lines.say: Niamh, the client just rang. They got the wrong price list?
lines.zh: Niamh，客戶剛打來，他們收到錯的價目表？

lines.say: Oh… em… the system was slow, and Ciara gave me the file, and nobody told me…
lines.zh: 喔……呃……系統很慢，然後是 Ciara 給我檔案的，也沒人跟我說……

lines.say: The mistake was small. The excuses made it big. Now my boss trusts me less.
lines.zh: 錯誤本來很小，是藉口把它變大的。現在老闆比較不信任我了。

lines.say: Everyone makes mistakes at work. What people remember is how you handle them.
lines.zh: 每個人工作都會出錯，大家記得的是你怎麼處理。

board.cta: 工作出錯好好道歉・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for when you get something wrong at work.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你工作出錯時用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for when you get something wrong at work.

lines.say: Owning it, explaining what happened, fixing it, and moving on.
lines.zh: 承認錯誤、說明經過、補救，還有往前走。

lines.say: Part one: own it.
lines.zh: 第一段：承認錯誤。

lines.say: Go to your manager before they come to you. That alone changes everything.
lines.zh: 在主管來找你之前，先去找主管。光這樣就差很多。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I'm afraid I've got some bad news. I made a mistake with the Murphy order.
scenes.meaning: 恐怕有個壞消息，Murphy 那張訂單我出錯了
scenes.note: I'm afraid ＝ 恐怕（帶出壞消息）

lines.say: I'm afraid I've got some bad news. I made a mistake with the Murphy order.
I'm afraid softens bad news. Then say exactly which thing went wrong.
lines.zh: I'm afraid 讓壞消息聽起來柔和一點，接著說出是哪件事出錯。

lines.say: Bad news doesn't get better with time. It gets worse.
lines.zh: 壞消息不會隨時間變好，只會變更糟。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm afraid I've got some bad news. I made a mistake with the Murphy order.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: That's on me. I should have double-checked.
scenes.meaning: 這是我的責任，我應該再檢查一次的
scenes.note: That's on me ＝ 這是我的責任

lines.say: Then take responsibility.
lines.zh: 接著承擔責任。

lines.say: That's on me. I should have double-checked.
That's on me means: it's my fault, not someone else's.
lines.zh: That's on me 意思是：是我的錯，不是別人的。

lines.say: I should have plus past participle is how we talk about past mistakes.
lines.zh: I should have 加過去分詞，是談過去錯誤的說法。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That's on me. I should have double-checked.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I'm not going to make excuses.

lines.say: And show you're serious.
lines.zh: 再表示你是認真的。

lines.say: I'm not going to make excuses.
Managers hear excuses all day. This sentence makes them listen.
lines.zh: 主管整天都在聽藉口，這句話會讓他們願意聽你說。

lines.say: And then, of course, really don't make any!
lines.zh: 然後，當然要真的不找藉口！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm not going to make excuses.

scenes.title: Explain
scenes.sub: 說明經過：講事實，不怪人

lines.say: Part two: explain what happened.
lines.zh: 第二段：說明經過。

lines.say: Facts, not feelings. And never blame a colleague.
lines.zh: 講事實，不講情緒。而且絕對不要怪同事。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: What happened was, I sent them last year's price list.
scenes.meaning: 事情是這樣的，我寄了去年的價目表給他們
scenes.note: What happened was ＝ 事情是這樣的

lines.say: What happened was, I sent them last year's price list.
What happened was introduces the facts. Short and simple.
lines.zh: What happened was 帶出事實，簡短就好。

lines.say: One sentence. Your manager doesn't need the whole story yet.
lines.zh: 一句話就好，主管現在還不需要整個故事。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What happened was, I sent them last year's price list.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: I didn't notice until this morning, when I checked the replies.
scenes.meaning: 我直到今天早上看回信才發現

lines.say: Then say when you found out.
lines.zh: 接著說你什麼時候發現的。

lines.say: I didn't notice until this morning, when I checked the replies.
Not until this morning means: this morning was the first moment I knew.
lines.zh: not until this morning 是：今天早上才第一次知道。

lines.say: It shows you're being honest about the timeline.
lines.zh: 這表示你對時間點很誠實。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I didn't notice until this morning, when I checked the replies.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: The good news is, it only went to one client.
scenes.meaning: 好消息是，只寄給了一個客戶
scenes.note: The good news is ＝ 好消息是

lines.say: And if there's something positive, say it.
lines.zh: 如果有好的一面，也說出來。

lines.say: The good news is, it only went to one client.
The good news is helps your manager see the size of the problem.
lines.zh: The good news is 幫主管看清楚問題有多大。

lines.say: Not to hide the mistake. Just to be accurate.
lines.zh: 不是要掩蓋錯誤，只是要說得準確。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: The good news is, it only went to one client.
Let's go back and do it properly.
lines.zh: 我們回去好好再來一次。

lines.say: Diego, I'm afraid I've got some bad news. I made a mistake with the Murphy order.
lines.zh: Diego，恐怕有個壞消息，Murphy 那張訂單我出錯了。

lines.say: Oh? What happened?
lines.zh: 喔？怎麼了？

lines.say: What happened was, I sent them last year's price list. That's on me. I should have double-checked.
lines.zh: 事情是這樣的，我寄了去年的價目表給他們。這是我的責任，我應該再檢查一次的。

lines.say: I see. Did anyone else get it?
lines.zh: 了解。還有其他人收到嗎？

lines.say: The good news is, it only went to one client.
lines.zh: 好消息是，只寄給了一個客戶。

lines.say: Calm, clear, honest. He's not angry, he's thinking.
lines.zh: 冷靜、清楚、誠實。他沒有生氣，而是在思考。

lines.say: Part three: fix it.
lines.zh: 第三段：補救。

lines.say: Never bring only a problem. Bring a solution too.
lines.zh: 不要只帶著問題來，也要帶著解決方法。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: I've already called them and apologised.
scenes.meaning: 我已經打電話跟他們道歉了
scenes.note: have already ＋ 過去分詞 ＝ 已經做了

lines.say: I've already called them and apologised.
I've already shows you didn't wait for instructions. You acted.
lines.zh: I've already 表示你沒有等人交代，你已經行動了。

lines.say: Managers love the word already.
lines.zh: 主管最愛聽到 already 這個字。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've already called them and apologised.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'll send them the correct prices by lunchtime.
scenes.meaning: 我午餐前會把正確的價格寄給他們

lines.say: Then give a clear next step, with a time.
lines.zh: 接著給一個明確的下一步，加上時間。

lines.say: I'll send them the correct prices by lunchtime.
By lunchtime means before lunch, at the latest.
lines.zh: by lunchtime 是最晚在午餐前。

lines.say: A deadline makes your promise real.
lines.zh: 有期限，你的承諾才算數。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'll send them the correct prices by lunchtime.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: From now on, I'll get a second pair of eyes on anything that goes to a client.
scenes.meaning: 以後寄給客戶的東西，我都會請別人再看一次
scenes.note: a second pair of eyes ＝ 再找一個人幫忙看

lines.say: And show it won't happen again.
lines.zh: 再表示不會再發生。

lines.say: From now on, I'll get a second pair of eyes on anything that goes to a client.
A second pair of eyes means another person checks your work.
lines.zh: a second pair of eyes 是請另一個人檢查你的工作。

lines.say: From now on shows you've learned something. That's what rebuilds trust.
lines.zh: From now on 表示你學到教訓了，這才能重建信任。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: From now on, I'll get a second pair of eyes on anything that goes to a client.

scenes.title: Move on
scenes.sub: 往前走：接受和給予原諒

lines.say: Part four: move on.
lines.zh: 第四段：往前走。

lines.say: After the mistake is fixed, don't keep apologising for days. Close it.
lines.zh: 錯誤補救好之後，不要一直道歉好幾天，就此結束。

lines.say: Thanks for being so understanding.
When your manager is kind about it, thank them.
lines.zh: 主管很體諒你的時候，要謝謝他。

lines.say: Understanding here is an adjective. It means patient and kind.
lines.zh: 這裡的 understanding 是形容詞，意思是有耐心又體貼。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for being so understanding.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.note: these things happen ＝ 這種事難免

lines.say: And when a colleague apologises to you, say this.
lines.zh: 同事跟你道歉時，就說這句。

lines.say: Don't worry, these things happen.
These things happen means: it's normal, everyone makes mistakes.
lines.zh: these things happen 是：很正常，每個人都會出錯。

lines.say: Be kind to others, the way you want them to be kind to you.
lines.zh: 像你希望別人怎麼對你一樣，善待別人。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Don't worry, these things happen.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.note: put it behind us ＝ 讓它過去

lines.say: And the last line, to close it for good.
lines.zh: 最後一句，讓這件事正式結束。

lines.say: Let's put it behind us.
Put it behind us means stop thinking about it, and move forward.
lines.zh: put it behind us 是不再想它，繼續往前。

lines.say: A mistake that's handled well can actually build trust.
lines.zh: 處理得好的錯誤，反而能建立信任。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Let's put it behind us.
I've already called them and apologised. I'll send them the correct prices by lunchtime.
lines.zh: 我已經打電話跟他們道歉了，午餐前會把正確的價格寄給他們。

lines.say: Good. That's exactly what I'd have done.
lines.zh: 很好，換作是我也會這樣做。

lines.say: From now on, I'll get a second pair of eyes on anything that goes to a client.
lines.zh: 以後寄給客戶的東西，我都會請別人再看一次。

lines.say: Don't worry, these things happen. Let's put it behind us.
lines.zh: 別擔心，這種事難免的。我們就讓它過去吧。

lines.say: Thanks for being so understanding.
lines.zh: 謝謝你這麼體諒。

lines.say: Same mistake. But this time, he trusts her more, not less.
lines.zh: 同樣的錯誤，但這次他反而更信任她了。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：搞砸時的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish phrases for when things go wrong.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！搞砸時的兩句愛爾蘭話。

lines.say: When you make a total mess of something, Irish people say this.
lines.zh: 把事情完全搞砸時，愛爾蘭人會這樣說。

lines.say: I made a hames of it.
A hames is a complete mess. It's very Irish, and a little bit funny, so it takes the pressure off.
lines.zh: hames 是一團糟。很愛爾蘭，又有點好笑，能讓氣氛輕鬆一點。

lines.say: And when a friend feels terrible about a mistake, say this.
lines.zh: 朋友為了錯誤很難過時，就這樣說。

lines.say: Don't be beating yourself up.
Beating yourself up means blaming yourself too much. Don't be plus i-n-g is very Irish.
lines.zh: beating yourself up 是過度自責。Don't be 加 ing 是很愛爾蘭的說法。

lines.say: Don't be beating yourself up.
Now the whole conversation, start to finish. Say my lines!
lines.zh: 現在把整段對話從頭到尾演一遍。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: I'm afraid I've got some bad news. I made a mistake with the Murphy order. I'm not going to make excuses.
lines.zh: 恐怕有個壞消息，Murphy 那張訂單我出錯了。我不會找藉口。

lines.say: OK. What happened?
lines.zh: 好，怎麼了？

lines.say: What happened was, I sent them last year's price list. I didn't notice until this morning, when I checked the replies.
lines.zh: 事情是這樣的，我寄了去年的價目表給他們。我直到今天早上看回信才發現。

lines.say: Right. Have you spoken to them?
lines.zh: 好。你跟他們聯絡了嗎？

lines.say: I've already called them and apologised. I made a hames of it, but it's fixed.
lines.zh: 我已經打電話跟他們道歉了。我搞砸了，但已經補救好了。

lines.say: Don't be beating yourself up. Let's put it behind us.
lines.zh: 別再自責了。我們就讓它過去吧。

items: I'm afraid I've got some bad news. I made a mistake with the Murphy order.
That's on me. I should have double-checked.
I'm not going to make excuses.
What happened was, I sent them last year's price list.
I didn't notice until this morning, when I checked the replies.
The good news is, it only went to one client.
I've already called them and apologised.
I'll send them the correct prices by lunchtime.
From now on, I'll get a second pair of eyes on anything that goes to a client.

lines.say: Brilliant! Own it, explain it, fix it, and move on.
lines.zh: 太棒了！承認、說明、補救，然後往前走。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them. I hope you never need them, but you probably will!
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖存起來。希望你用不到，但你大概會用到！

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And always double-check your attachments! See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 還有，附件一定要再檢查一次！下一課見，Bye！
